_readme: The class board: which cooking school runs which sessions, on which days, from what time, for what posted price — read by cooking_layer.py for /cooking.html and the band on each school's page. Curated, never crawled; the same facts sit on the records through data/curated/enrich.json so the school's own page shows them too. Every row names WHO stated the sessions (`stated_by`) and where (`source`, `fetched`). `sessions` holds only what the school itself states; `days` holds BYDAY codes only when the school states weekdays ("closed Sundays", "open daily", "365 days") and is null when it does not — null means NOT STATED, never closed. What a listing or a reseller says would go in `days_reported`, by name and date, and render as reported; as of the first board nothing has had to. Prices follow the same rule as everywhere on this site: `_pricesVerified` stays false until somebody reads the board at the door, and a card or page says so. A row with `place` null is a school whose own site was read but whose record could not be tied to an OpenStreetMap record by the strict matcher (`maybe_place` names the candidate, for a person). Schools on the shelf that state nothing are listed by the page itself under 'ask first' — they are not rows here. Deliberately NOT fed into events.json: a daily class is a booking, not a happening.
